concept: simple premium industrial engineering UI; independently releasable and ready for future VERTEX VISION mount

information_architecture.projects: construction and engineering projects with lifecycle, estimate, equipment, tasks and history
information_architecture.equipment: elevators, ventilation, heating, air conditioning and other engineering assets
information_architecture.service: one work-order center for all equipment
information_architecture.team: specialists, skills, licenses/certificates and assigned work
information_architecture.documents: contracts, estimates, drawings, licenses, certificates, commissioning and service reports

rules: Keep six top-level work areas only.
Do not create a separate application for every engineering discipline.
Compliance is surfaced contextually in Team, Equipment and Documents.
Use sand as a VERTEX family accent, not as the only surface color.
Technical data must remain legible before decorative styling.
Red is reserved for incidents, failed inspection or expired compliance.
Preview must not invent business records or imply unconnected persistence is live.
